regions.full_page: A. Mc K. tenant refuses to pay rent of $70.00 and is about to leave rooms. Landlady enrolles him in S.M.A. Oct. 7th. He pays up Oct 14 and remains a friendly tennant.

regions.full_page: Harry Barkowski cast out from home by drinking father at 8, right after 1st Holy Communion. He wanders away unheard from 17 years. Was Enrolled three times by interested Aunt. Weeping for joy she reports To-day, having received letter from her same lost nephew announcing his hope of receiving "First Holy Communion again" (Af- ter 17 yrs, concludes: "We are going to start tomorrow at 3 a.m. and drive to Jackson to see him receve" - being Feast of All Saints.

regions.full_page: Peace Reconciliation Vocation. Albert H. Ouimet chooses Glenclyffe to study for the Order getting along fine (his uncle paying all ... ) On hearing of choice his Father raves and demands immediate return home ... abusive letter sent to the uncle. Same uncle enrolls the offender & Family in S.M.A. and sends certificate. This letter crosses in the mails with a letter of apology and complete change of disposition of said father . . 4/18/29 Boy doing fine.

regions.full_page: Hoplessly Insane of Yesterday Is brought Home Same day. John T. Mc- Gregor, 32 of Onaway, Mich. reported violently insane in Ann Arbor now two weeks. Before going thither yesterday, his Mother "heart-broken" and his uncle enrolled him in S.M.A. and were ex- horted to "go out to Jesus in the Tabernacle and promise a good number of holy Communions if they find him improving. Reported "violent" that same yesterday morning, they find him ready and actually bring him home with them. He comes to the Monastery this evening with his happy uncle and tells of his sudden recovery. He & Mother will leave for home tomorrow.

regions.full_page: Fractured Scull Recovery. Herman Kopp 27 of 6434 Craig Ave. re- ceives badly fractured scull - struck by 12 1b iron that had bro- ken loose and been thrown 35 ft. Strapped to bed and unconscious for two days, his anxious wife enrolls him Nov. 20th a perpetual member. Same night he sleeps well and since is rapidly improving. D. Gr!
